purpose: Customer Intent Profile as a first-class data model. Every customer has one. It shapes every downstream recommendation - which design tier surfaces first, which suppliers get shown, what tone NEX uses.
philosophy: A homeowner planning a Victorian restoration and a developer building 30 units want completely different things from the same platform. Intent Profile captures who the customer is so NEX can serve them appropriately.

customer_type.affects: tone of communication, level of technical detail, which suppliers surface

budget_tier.capture_method: Ask a range not a specific number (e.g. '£6-12k') or 'unsure'
budget_tier.affects: which design options appear, which suppliers match, which quote tier is default
budget_tier.note: Customers often understate budget out of caution. NEX shows their tier plus one up so they can see the difference.

priority.capture_method: Ask 'What matters most to you?' with these as suggestions
priority.affects: ranking of design options, presentation order of suppliers, urgency of milestones

style_preference.capture_method: Show 6-9 example images and let customer pick favourites; OR ask directly
style_preference.affects: design engine style filter, avoid[] rules, material recommendations

house_type.capture_method: Ask directly; if unknown, offer visual examples
house_type.affects: regs context, typical property assumptions from country pack, style compatibility warnings

timeline.capture_method: Ask 'When would you like the work completed?'
timeline.affects: supplier availability filter, lead-time flag on quotes, urgency in notifications

children_in_home.affects: activates child-safety rules (100mm sphere, no horizontal-rail balustrades), design engine avoid[] extended

elderly_or_mobility_user.affects: handrail height + both-side handrail recommendations, stairlift consideration, contrast nosing suggestion

pets_in_home.affects: finish durability recommendations (harder-wearing lacquer or oil), tread material advice

current_stair_status.capture_method: Ask early - drives whole project scope
current_stair_status.affects: assessment focus, design engine refurbish vs replace, supplier matching

postcode.affects: regional supplier matching, country pack context, regional labour multiplier in quote engine

notes.capture_method: Free text - anything the customer wants to add
notes.affects: notes are shared with matched trades in structured enquiry

capture_strategy.principle: Never front-load the customer with a form. Capture progressively as it becomes relevant.

phased_capture.reason: Needed for any answer to be relevant
Shapes photo analysis and safety flags

refinement_over_time.principle: Intent Profile evolves as NEX learns from customer behaviour.

signals_to_watch.signal: customer selects premium option 3 times in a row
signals_to_watch.action: Update budget_tier upward if not explicitly set
Confirm timeline as standard, not urgent

signals_to_watch.signal: customer edits budget upward after seeing options
signals_to_watch.action: Explicit customer update - no inference needed

refinement_over_time.user_control: Customer can view and edit intent profile at any time. Never inferred without a way to correct.

example_homeowner_price_first_mid_budget.design_engine: Present mid tier first, include entry-tier variant, defer premium/luxury unless asked
example_homeowner_price_first_mid_budget.supplier_matching: Prefer verified regional over premium national brands; show trade-account bonus
example_homeowner_price_first_mid_budget.quote_engine: Lead with lower range of estimate; itemise labour vs material transparently

example_architect_craftsmanship_first_pr.design_engine: Present premium and luxury tiers; skip entry; emphasise curved/floating options
example_architect_craftsmanship_first_pr.supplier_matching: Prefer bespoke manufacturers with portfolio evidence; skip kit specialists
example_architect_craftsmanship_first_pr.quote_engine: Show full range; emphasise material specification and finishing detail

example_builder_speed_first_mid_budget_v.design_engine: Show mid tier; emphasise standard specs that can be manufactured quickly
example_builder_speed_first_mid_budget_v.supplier_matching: Filter by lead-time availability; highlight trade-account merchants
example_builder_speed_first_mid_budget_v.quote_engine: Show fast-track lead-time badge; note if premium options add weeks

example_elderly_customer_safety_first_mi.design_engine: Prefer classic_period; both-side handrails default; contrast nosings; no open risers
example_elderly_customer_safety_first_mi.quote_engine: Include cost of both-side handrails, contrast nosings, stairlift-ready design if relevant

privacy_and_consent: Intent profile fields are captured with explicit consent per GDPR
Customer can view all captured data at any time
Customer can delete their profile - project retention rules per project workflow doc
Trade partners see only the fields relevant to the enquiry (structured summary), not raw profile
not_in_v1: Machine-learning-based style inference from browsing behaviour (rules-based inference only in V1)
Multi-property profiles (developer / architect with many parallel projects)
Household composition beyond binary flags (children / elderly / pets)
Preferred payment method capture (comes with payment integration in V2)
